changelog: Paraphrased C1 to be more concise and explicit about the two core questions so overall prompt size stayed controlled (addresses general clarity).
Replaced C2 to keep the original contra guidance but add an explicit instruction to treat very short, scope-bearing continuations as high-risk (addresses finding 1).
Rewrote C3 to keep cohesion guidance while adding an explicit penalty for cuts that isolate function-word–only fragments and to be more concise (addresses finding 3).
Replaced example E2 with the measured labeled example en_us_738 so the model learns a real-case ranking where short negation/auxiliary continuations are high-risk (addresses finding 1 directly).
Replaced E1 with labeled example en_us_1294 to teach the risk from short, scope-bearing continuations (negation/predicate fragments).
Replaced E2 with labeled example en_us_733 to teach preferring early cuts that isolate an initial head/preamble so the predicate stays intact.
Replaced E3 with labeled example en_us_337 to teach penalizing cuts that leave function-word–only fragments (e.g., isolated determiners) and to show a tight preamble/predicate split.
